provenance: Larry's son's written report, sent to the archive on the evening of 2026-09-05, answering the archive's questions about what Larry said at the table while drawing that afternoon. His son listened and did not take notes, so this is his summary from memory in his own words, not Larry's words.
text: Yes he mentioned the generators on the mountain. He said he would change them or add gas to them or do something to them when he was up there.
researchNotes: First mention of generators anywhere in his testimony, made while drawing VD-0002 and labelling them GENERATORS. What they powered, whose they were, and what exactly he did to them are open; his son's 'or do something to them' marks the limit of what was heard. Ledger #35.
